events.deciding_variable: Headline beat-and-raise was a one-time tariff refund. Q2 operating profit $211M vs $103M LY included a $161M NET IEEPA refund benefit, so underlying OI was ~$50M against a $45-50M guide - the top of the guide, not a beat. FY26 OI 'raised' $390-410M -> $540-550M, but the prior guide EXCLUDED refunds and the new one is 'inclusive of net tariff refund benefit': $545M - $161M = ~$384M vs a $400M midpoint, a ~4% CUT.
events.lesson: Reports and guides operating income on a basis that CHANGES between quarters. The May guide said in terms 'Guidance excludes any impact from IEEPA tariff refunds'; the September guide is 'inclusive of net tariff refund benefit'. Always strip the refund and restate both sides before calling a guide a raise or a cut.

standing_notes: Guides FY operating income with an explicit tariff-refund INCLUSION/EXCLUSION clause that has already flipped once (excl. at Q1 FY26, incl. at Q2 FY26). The clause is in the press-release outlook table - read it before comparing any two AEO guides. A raise on a changed basis is not a raise.
